body_html:
Walked in the door and the better half whisked my eldest off to basketball. I am off to go play Cub Scout Den Leader with my other two. Going to focus on the Paws on Path and Air of the Wolf tonight.

Last meeting we focused on our Do Not Litter campaign and learned to write an editorial and build a website.We then flew some paper planes.

Tonight we are going to graph the difference in height between bouncing an inflated and deflated ball and then add additional force as a variable. Finally we will compare our models.

Then we will play a few games to practice catching and balancing. #Tigers #Pack22
